title: Exception traits — AI Decision (phase 2)
proves: The ai-decision plugin sorts its exception codes by whether the node delivered: a confidence below the designer's floor is a decision that keeps routing under stopOnError, while a provider error past its retry budget still fails the node and still loses its branch.

services.what: nothing listening (the point of branch B)

notes: Branch A's floor is deliberately unsatisfiable (1.0), so the question always takes the exception edge; the seeded case is genuinely ambiguous, so the low confidence is earned (0.406 when first verified). Before v0.4.5 branch A behaved like branch B — min_confidence defeated itself. With stopOnError off, both exception markers fire and the error count stays 1.
